title: Accelerating ab initio melting property calculations with machine learning: application to the high entropy alloy TaVCrW

recollection.intervention: Machine learning applied to accelerate ab initio melting property calculations
recollection.structure: High entropy alloy structure with potential melting property predictions
recollection.mechanism: Machine learning models trained on ab initio data to predict melting properties efficiently
recollection.results: Likely improved computational efficiency and accurate predictions of melting properties for TaVCrW, but specific quantitative results are unknown.

score.note: The recollection only restates the title-level use of machine learning for accelerating melting calculations. It omits the specific MTP-for-liquid and FEP-for-TI substitutions, the BCC/disordered state and sub-1 meV/atom MTP fidelity, the FEP variance/convergence mechanism and electronic/SRO contributions, and all numerical results.
